persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Can you show how my kitchen could look renovated? Make one 16:9 before-and-after image, original on the left and your realistic makeover on the right. White shaker cabinets, light oak counters, white subway tiles, no clutter. Keep the same room layout and camera angle. Label them “Before” and “After”.
bank.Source photo and panel order: Use kitchen-before.jpg unchanged on the left and generate its renovated version for the right.
bank.Renovation style: Photorealistic white shaker cabinets, light oak counters, white subway tiles and cleared counters.
bank.What should stay the same?: The room layout, perspective, camera angle and positions of existing major fixtures.
bank.Label wording and language: Before and After, exactly, in English.
bank.Size and format: One landscape 16:9 comparison image; free-tier resolution is fine.
bank.Typography and layout details: Equal-sized side-by-side panels with readable labels; other styling is your call.

messages.text: Can you show me how my kitchen in this pic could look renovated, using the attached kitchen-before.jpg as the starting point? I've been thinking about a renovation for a while, and seeing it pictured would help me imagine the change. I'd like white shaker cabinets, light oak counters, white subway tiles, and no clutter, and somewhere in all that I should mention that I want one 16:9 before-and-after image with the original on the left and your realistic makeover on the right. Please keep the same room layout and camera angle, so it still feels like I'm looking at my own kitchen. Label the two sides exactly “Before” and “After”.
